prompt:
Protect the API with keys and roles.
- Requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys live in the data as `apiKeys: [{ "key", "name", "role" }]`; add one key per role to data/seed.json.
- Roles: `viewer` may only read (GET). `cook` may also cook recipes, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. `manager` may do everything.
- A request without a key or with an unknown key is 401; a known key without permission is 403. Both answer in the usual error shape with their own error codes.
- Every request that changes data writes an audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status). `GET /audit` lists them newest first and is for managers only.
Update the existing tests so they send a key.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer:
The API now needs a bearer key, and its role decides what the key can do. A missing or unknown key gets 401 `unauthorized`, even for routes that don't exist. A known key without permission gets 403 `forbidden`. Every non-GET request from a known key adds one audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status), including failed or refused ones. Managers read the log newest first at `GET /audit`. Each request still saves the store once, now after the audit entry is added. All 31 tests and lint pass offline.

- **Roles:** `viewer` can call every GET except `/audit`. `cook` can also cook a recipe, record waste, log a temperature and enter stock-take counts. Starting and finishing a stock-take is for managers only, because the task named only counts. `manager` can do everything.
- **Seed keys:** `data/seed.json` has `seed-viewer-key`, `seed-cook-key` and `seed-manager-key`, plus an empty `audit` list. These keys are committed, so they are for development only.
- **Decision for you:** `npm start` serves `data/db.json`, which I left alone because the task only named seed.json. It has no keys, so every request to it is refused with 401 until you add an `apiKeys` entry.
- **No schema version bump:** `apiKeys` and `audit` are optional lists, the same way `stocktakes` and `temperatures` were added. Files without them still open.
- **Tests:** the test helper now sends the manager key by default. I also added `tests/auth.test.js` to cover the 401/403 cases, each role's permissions and the audit log. The docs (README, API, DATA) and the changelog are updated.

check.why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
